To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The phylum Nemetoda is biologically rich and diverse.

1) the phylum Nematode has a large repertoire of novel proteins, and that 2) these proteins are evolving in a lineage specific manner, and that 3) some of these novel genes have signatures consistent with horizontal transfer from their hosts, and that 4) parasitic nematodes are enriched for these novel, lineage-specific genes, especially secreted genes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the evolutionary processes that have led to the biological diversity that we observe in the Nematoda.
understanding the origins of the diversity of nematode species by analyzing the extent and origins of genic novelty.
the evolution of parasitic nematode genes and proteins, and the extent and origins of novel genes and proteins in the Nematoda.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Nematoda are characterized by a preponderance and diversity of novelty, and this novelty has been generated by a combination of gene loss and de novo origin of new genes.
nematodes have a lot more genes than C. elegans and that the genes are evolving in a very interesting and diverse fashion, including a lot of horizontal gene transfer.
the nematode genome contains a large number of genes that have arisen de novo in the lineage leading to nematodes and are not shared with other phyla.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Nematoda are a highly derived group of animals with a large repertoire of gene novelty, including a substantial number of genes that are specific to parasitic taxa.
the Nematoda are a diverse phylum with a large repertoire of protein domains, many of which are unique to this phylum.
the phylum Nematode is a rich source of novel genes and that these are being generated at a high rate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a huge amount of genetic novelty in the Nematoda.
the Nematoda are a diverse and dynamic group, with a large number of genes and domains that are unique to the phylum, and that are evolving rapidly.
the Nematoda have a very large repertoire of genes that is not seen in any other phyla.
